T.O.P (Choi Seung-hyun), born November 4, 1987, is a South Korean rapper, actor, and artist known as the lead rapper of BIGBANG. Standing approximately 181cm (5'11") tall, the Scorpio artist is renowned for his deep husky voice. Notable works include solo hits "DOOM DADA" and his contributions to BigBang hits like "Fantastic Baby" and "Bang Bang Bang". Key Details About T.O.P Full Name: Choi Seung-hyun (최승현).
